description: A master clock with a start pulse, an undivided gate and four divided gates whose divisions are picked by two switches

params.text: Picks the upper or the lower row of the numbers printed beside the four divided jacks
Sets the clock speed within the band picked by the switch beside it
Picks the band the two speed knobs work in, a fast one or a slow one
Trims the clock speed around the setting of the larger knob
Sets how much of each count the gates stay high, from a quarter of it upwards
Runs the clock in one position and holds it stopped in the other; leaving the stopped position fires the start jack
Shifts the divided gates by one count, moving them onto the upbeat
Picks the left or the right column of the numbers printed beside the four divided jacks

inputs.text: Slows the clock, a tenth of the speed knob's travel per volt, with the total clamped at the ends of the band
Widens the gates, a twentieth of the width knob's travel per volt

outputs.text: A 5V gate at the division printed beside this jack for the row and column the two switches are set to
A 5V pulse 100ms long, fired each time the clock leaves the stopped position

inputs.0:
±5V · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±5V · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
